## Context
Document the threat model (STRIDE or similar) and create scripted attack scenarios for the demo panel.

## Requirements
- Documented threat model (STRIDE, MITRE ATT&CK, or similar framework)
- Identify threats: spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, DoS, privilege escalation
- Scripted attack scenarios: replay attack, counter regression, session hijack, MITM
- Scenarios feed into Attack Lab API and demo panel
- Demonstrate detection and mitigation for each scenario

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Threat model documented with identified threats and mitigations
- [ ] Attack scenarios scripted (replay, counter regression, hijack, MITM)
- [ ] Scenarios integrated with Attack Lab API
- [ ] Detection and mitigation demonstrated for each scenario
